rules.requirement: Each night, choose a player: if they nominate tomorrow, they die. If just 3 players live, you lose this ability.

assertingTests.name: the Witch curse kills the nominator but keeps the nomination (SNV-WITCH-01)
a placed Witch curse does not kill after the Witch dies or is impaired (SNV-WITCH-01)
